candidates.name: Tuberous Sclerosis Complex
support_spans: skin-colored, dome-shaped firm papules over the chin, nose, and perinasal region
dozens of skin-colored dome-shaped papules over the chin, nasal, and perinasal regions of the face
Histologic Analysis: First biopsy of facial papule showed a dome-shaped lesion with several plump fibroblasts and increased blood vessels, compatible with an angiofibroma
contradict_spans: No hypopigmented macules, periungual fibromas, or Shagreen plaques were present
candidates.why: The presence of angiofibromas, which are characteristic of Tuberous Sclerosis Complex, along with the patient's history of renal transplant, which could be related to renal angiomyolipomas also seen in TSC, supports this diagnosis.
